reference_id.description: A unique, randomly generated hex value that identifies your web service request.

sub_resource.description: The subresource accessed for the request. This is always `sms` for the SMS Verify API.

errors.description: Contains an object for each error condition that resulted from the request.

status.description: Contains details about the request status.

code.description: A numeric code indicating the processing status of this request.

updated_on.description: An RFC 3339 timestamp indicating when the transaction status was updated.

verify.description: Contains properties about the status of the verification attempt by the end user (if any).

code_state.description:
Indicates whether the verification code you provided in your request matches that sent by Telesign to the end-user. Possible values are: 
* `VALID` - The codes match. 
* `INVALID` - The codes do not match.
* `EXPIRED` - The match was attempted after the end of the validity period for the code.
* `MAX_ATTEMPTS_EXCEEDED` - The match was attempted after the end user already had made the maximum allowed number of attempts for the code.
* `UNKNOWN` - Any other state.

code_entered.description: If the end user entered a code, what they entered is provided here.

additionalInfo.title: additionalInfo
additionalInfo.description: Contains properties relevant when the message sent with this transaction is one of several parts of a longer message that was split. This object only appears if this feature is enabled for your account. Contact our [Customer Support Team](mailto:support@telesign.com) to request this feature.

message_part_sequence_number.description: Indicates this message's position in the series of split parts.

message_parts_count.description: The total number of split parts for the longer message. If the message is not split, this value is `1`.

message_parts_reference_ids.description: The reference IDs for each part of the longer message, separated by commas.

errorObject.title: errorObject
errorObject.description: Contains properties related to an error that occurred during processing of the request.

code.description: A numeric code specifying which error occurred.

description.description: Text describing the error that occurred.
